entities.summary: Aubrey Lafell Dawkins is an American professional basketball player for APU Udine of the Lega Basket Serie A (LBA). He played college basketball for the UCF Knights, transferring to UCF after completing his sophomore season for the 2015–16 Michigan Wolverines. He is the son of Johnny Dawkins who became the UCF coach following the 2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season.
